newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil CVRD still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil CVRD still a buy.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said it maintained its buy rating on Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce
-- The bank said it believes CVRD's privatization has reached a point of no return and it is confident that approximately within a year CVRD will be completely privatized.

-- It also said that Vale's new gold and copper reserves, if proven and shared equally between CVRD and the government, should add approximately $900 million to $1.2 billion to its previous valuation of the company, "making CVRD's fair valuation at $11.5 billion, or approximately $30 per share."
-- Vale's sell-off is expected to begin in April.
-- Vale preferred shares were up 4.21 percent to 26 reais at 1600 local time/1800 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
